propositions: RemoteRef is never constructed in production code; the port member remote_ref() is undeclared on Backend and unimplemented by real backends, though FakeBackend has implemented it since J7

instance field must be derived from configured base URL at construction time and injected, not resolved at call time, to avoid config-resolution hazards in contract tests and to prevent runtime property-lookup failures across Python versions

instance does not prevent local-ticket-id collision between same-vendor deployments because _jira_key_to_local_id derives ids from Jira keys alone; vendor already separates Cloud from DC, so the docstring claim must be corrected in both ADRs

both concrete backends must implement remote_ref() receiving instance as a constructor parameter from build_backend factories, and contract tests must construct real backends with explicit instance and no ambient config to prove constructor-state reading
